hints.title: Midpoint Detection in Cycle
hints.text: Advance a slow pointer by one step and a fast pointer by two steps until fast completes one full cycle around the ring.

hints.title: Two-Halves Splitting
hints.text: When fast is at the last or second-to-last node of the cycle, slow points to the end of the first half.

hints.title: Closing Both Circular Lists
hints.text: Point slow.next back to head, point the last node back to the start of the second half, and return both list heads.

hints.title: Fast and Slow Pointer Splitting Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def splitCircularLinkedList(self, list: Optional[ListNode]) -> list[Optional[ListNode]]:
        slow = list
        fast = list
        while fast.next != list and fast.next.next != list:
            slow = slow.next
            fast = fast.next.next
        if fast.next.next == list:
            fast = fast.next
        head2 = slow.next
        slow.next = list
        fast.next = head2
        return [list, head2]
```

variables: n: number of nodes in circular list
complexity.notes: Single pass pointer traversal finding midpoint.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unlinking nodes without tracking the cycle tail causes infinite loops.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies Floyd cycle traversal to locate midpoint and safely resets both circular tails.
